tk921bwz.variantName: My Christmas 4ft Artificial PE Christmas Tree with 320 Tips - Green
tk921bwz.sourceDescription: Bring a natural, lifelike touch to your festive décor with this artificial Christmas tree, crafted entirely from premium polyethylene (PE) with moulded needles that recreate the texture and appearance of real pine. Its dense, full branches provide reliable support for Christmas baubles, garlands and lights while maintaining their shape throughout the festive season. Made from durable, flame-retardant PE, the tree is designed for repeated seasonal use with minimal needle shedding. The solid wooden stand provides stable support and adds a warm, natural finish that complements a variety of interior styles. Supplied in three sections, the tree features hinged branches that open automatically when connected, allowing for quick assembly and easy shaping. Specifications: Made from 100% PE with realistic moulded needles, dense branches, a durable flame-retardant construction and a solid wooden stand. Supplied in three sections with hinged branches for convenient assembly, storage and reuse. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

71vg0m0r.baseName: Walplus 150 Bright LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
71vg0m0r.variantName: Walplus 150 Bright LED Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
71vg0m0r.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 95 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Number of PVC tips: 340 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
